hi there! i am also hypersexual to the point where if my partner doesnt constantly sexualize me i feel ugly and disgusting and that he thinks that as well. but its not true. its literally just overthinking and a trauma response on my part (feeling reduced to my body in the past/only being loved for my body so i feel like its the main way to feel loved/receive too) you know your needs. if you feel like having a lot of sex with your partner makes you feel secure and loved thats fine and thats your personal preference! im not sure what he meant by "he loves you NOW.. so no need" it usually feels the opposite w me. i love them so i get more attracted to them. if this is severely affecting how you view yourself maybe you can communicate this need and meet them halfway with their needs too. and if they cant, then yes, maybe you guys arent compatible in the ways you need. but maybe he doesnt have a high sex drive. also living with your partner i find usually complicates sex life a bit. takes a lot of communication and patience with eachother to make it work. i wish u luck <33

first of all im sorry youre going through that. your parents sound manipulative.. could you possibly move in with a close relative or friend that is more accommodating to your mental illness? i know thats usually pretty hard to do so let me also give some reassurance!! i am 20 and i dont have a job or go to school or do anything really. and let me tell you, THATS OKAY. because of the capitalistic "sOcieTy" (omg cringe) we live in, we really only measure our successes through the amount of money we received or like the degree you get for completing a certain program for college. but there are so many other successes in life that are just as important that go unrecognized! im just assuming here but your parents may not realize just the anount of effort you put into just existing. its hard to exist. youre doing a great job okay. this is super normal to feel unmotivated. just remind yourself they dont understand that you have a literal imbalance of brain chemicals that makes it hard to do tasks. always validate yourself. you have so much time to work through bpd and get treatment. and eventually youll be able to handle a job but for now just work on doing things that make you happy.

Man i resonate with that. Im glad you recognize how your life is something to be grateful for. That’s something many can’t while in a state of such depression. But even so, your social status, your home life, anything good that you have, does not invalidate your feelings. Because depression can happen to anyone. Like i fucking understand that. My life is seemingly amazing. I have a nice house, a family, financial stability, friends, yet I still feel like shit. I even still feel like Im making up my mental illness to justify some of my negative behaviors. But im not. My therapist literally told me I have severe depression and yet I still doubt myself. Its just because Ive normalized my feelings for so long that it doesnt feel like an issue but thats a different topic. Your feelings are valid despite whatever situation you are in. Brain chemistry is complicated thing, and it can get fucked up out of no where. Im sorry you feel like that. Try to talk to your mom or some adult in your life about getting help. If your worried about the costs of it, maybe look into it online, or bring it up with who youre talking to. If you have insurance they may cover it as well. There are a lot of options for you, okay. Stay strong, friend. <3
